svg.title: Outcomes: 3M → 10M+ monthly search impressions on a platform I've owned since 2021; 100K+ monthly active users supported with zero-downtime releases; −45% page load time after monolith-to-headless migrations; −35% release cycle time after standardising CI/CD; 95%+ on-time sprint completion for the team I lead and mentor
